author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಂಧಕಾರದೆ ಕರದಿ ಬೆಳಕಿರದೆ ನಡೆವಂತೆ
ಬಂಧಗಳಿಗಂಟುತಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದು ಏಳುವೆಯೊ
ಸಂಧಿಸದೆ ಜ್ಞಾನವನು ಆಲಸ್ಯ ಮನೆಮಾಡೆ
ಮಂದನಡೆ ತಮವದುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Like walking in darkness without a lamp in hand,
tangled in bonds, you fall and rise again;
when you do not meet knowledge and sloth makes its home,
that sluggish walk is tamas, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Life without knowledge is like groping in the dark: we trip over attachments again and again. Laziness that shuts out learning is tamas, the quality of inertia.
